title: Enrollment application
short: Apply for a place in any AGI program
intro: Apply for a place at AGI, from kindergarten to grade 12, the adult high school diploma, Anglia English or special education. Send one application per student.
have: The student's previous school records and a behavior report
Proof of age and residency
Immunization and physical examination records
For an IEP or special-needs support: documentation from a licensed practitioner
next: Admissions contacts you to arrange the free placement test and a visit. Registration days for 2026–27 are August 28 and 31. The annual inscription is paid once at enrollment and is non-refundable.

fields.name: confirm
fields.label: I confirm the information is accurate and understand that the annual inscription is non-refundable.

children.text: Admissions contacts you to arrange the free placement test and a visit. Registration days for 2026–27 are August 28 and 31. The annual inscription is paid once at enrollment and is non-refundable.

title: Visit the school
short: Book a tour of the Agadir campus
intro: Tours are arranged individually so you can meet the team, see the classrooms and ask about the application process.
have: Two or three dates that suit you
The program you are interested in
next: The office confirms a time by phone or email. Visits take place Monday to Friday at 20 Rue Baalabek, Hay Nahda.

children.text: The office confirms a time by phone or email. Visits take place Monday to Friday at 20 Rue Baalabek, Hay Nahda.

title: Report an absence
short: Absence, late arrival or early pick-up
intro: Let the office know before 9:00 on the day if your child will be absent, arrive late or leave early.
have: Your child's name and grade
The dates, and the reason for the absence
next: The office records your notice. School policy still asks for a dated, signed excuse within two days of your child's return. Arriving after 10:00 counts as a full-day absence, and promotion requires 90% attendance.

children.text: The office records your notice. School policy still asks for a dated, signed excuse within two days of your child's return. Arriving after 10:00 counts as a full-day absence, and promotion requires 90% attendance.

title: Park & outdoor activity consent
short: Permission for park visits and outings
intro: Give permission for your child to join a park visit or outdoor microschool activity. Send one form per child, per activity, before the activity date.
have: The name and date of the activity
An emergency phone number for the day
Any allergies, medication or health notes
next: Teachers receive your consent before the activity. If anything changes on the day, call the office.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: I give permission for my child to take part in this activity, supervised by AGI staff.

children.text: Teachers receive your consent before the activity. If anything changes on the day, call the office.

title: Parent feedback
intro: Tell us what is working, what could be better, or a concern you want the administration to know about. You can stay anonymous.
have: A specific example helps us act on your feedback
next: The administration reviews all feedback every week. If you ask for a reply, we contact you.

children.text: The administration reviews all feedback every week. If you ask for a reply, we contact you.
New submission from the AGI website (Parent feedback):

title: Payment notice
short: Tell the office about a payment you made
intro: Let the office know about a payment you have made, so it is matched to the right student and a receipt is issued.
have: Your transfer reference, cheque number or receipt number
The student's name and the months the payment covers
next: The office checks the payment and confirms by email. As a reminder: the annual inscription is paid once at enrollment, then tuition is 2,600 MAD a month over ten months.

children.text: The office checks the payment and confirms by email. As a reminder: the annual inscription is paid once at enrollment, then tuition is 2,600 MAD a month over ten months.

title: Order Step To books
short: Anglia preparation books and teachers' guides
intro: Order Anglia Step To workbooks and teachers' guides for any level, for yourself, your child, your class or your centre.
have: The levels you need
How many copies of each
Where the books should go
next: The office confirms availability, the price and the delivery or collection date, then sends you payment details.

title: Request a tutor
short: One-to-one support in Agadir or online
intro: Ask for one-to-one tutoring in English, mathematics or another subject, in Agadir or online.
have: The subject and the learner's current level or grade
What you want to achieve
When the learner is free
next: The office matches you with a qualified tutor, usually within 48 hours, and confirms the price and schedule with you.

short: Set or change your session times

The days and times that work for you
next: Your tutor confirms the schedule, or proposes another time if a slot is taken.

The years the student attended
Where the document needs to go
